reviewMethod: Entire candidate reviewed using reversible factoring of the six repeated prefixes/suffixes and each of41 exact shared move reasons; all values and non-judgment fields reviewed.
finding: Each move has a useful source-specific sentence, but repeats that identical sentence across all six dimensions with generic criterion boilerplate. This leaves different ratings and distinct strengths/limitations unexplained and does not establish that one limitation is not deducted repeatedly. Zero-adjustment descriptions are also generic.
requiredCorrection: In original unsaved context give the actual source-based reason for each dimension and explain distinct consequences where one defect affects multiple dimensions. Retain existing numerical values and confidence; if any cannot honestly be supported, report instead of inventing justification. For con-physics-analogy-and-missing-premise distinguish actual argumentative organization from caption/speaker-recognition uncertainty: the latter may not reduce clarity. Ensure a-posteriori wording is confirmed speech rather than recognition noise. Preserve worldview-truth stipulation and no cutoff inference. Identify actual debate-wide consequences already captured in zero-adjustment reasons.
attemptBoundary: No first submission. No peer values or direction disclosed; no new context, score or retry.
